Notes on reading in the dock

The docked reader sits beside the page in a panel 420 pixels wide. The page keeps working next to it: links can be followed and the page scrolls as usual.

Elements fixed to the right edge of the window would otherwise end up under the panel. The bar across the top would lose its right end, and the help button would be hidden.

What moves

When the dock opens, fixed elements whose box reaches into the panel's strip move out from under it. A bar that spans the window becomes narrower; a button at the right edge moves left by the panel's width.

When the dock closes, their own inline styles come back exactly as they were, so the page looks as it did before.

What does not

Elements the page adds after the dock opens are not moved. That is a known limit and the README says so.
